## What is a hook

Command hooks run on configured events and receive JSON on stdin. Other hook types include prompt, agent, HTTP and MCP tool hooks; availability depends on the event.

## Main events

| Event | Moment | Can block |
|-------|--------|-----------|
| `SessionStart` | Startup or resume | No |
| `SessionEnd` | Session ends | No |
| `UserPromptSubmit` | Before prompt processing | Yes |
| `PreToolUse` | Before a tool call | Yes |
| `PostToolUse` | After a tool succeeds | No |
| `PreCompact` | Before context compaction | Yes |
| `Notification` | Claude sends a notification | No |
| `Stop` | Claude finishes responding | Yes |
| `SubagentStop` | A sub-agent ends | Yes |

## Multi-agent and configuration events

| Event | Since | Use |
|-------|-------|-----|
| `TeammateIdle` | v2.1.32+ (Agent Teams) | A team member is about to go idle |
| `TaskCompleted` | v2.1.32+ (Agent Teams) | A task is about to be marked complete |
| `ConfigChange` | v2.1.49+ | A config file changed during the session |

Team gates can request further work before completion. `ConfigChange` audits configuration independently of Agent Teams.

## Configuration in settings.json

```json
{
  "hooks": {
    "PreToolUse": [{
      "matcher": "Bash",
      "hooks": [{
        "type": "command",
        "command": "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR}/.claude/hooks/security.sh",
        "args": [], "timeout": 10
      }]
    }]
  }
}
```

## Configuration fields

| Field | Usage |
|-------|-------|
| `command` | Executable when `args` is present; otherwise shell command |
| `args` | Arguments passed to `command` without a shell; does not replace the executable |
| `timeout` | Seconds; defaults: command 600, prompt 30, agent 60 |
| `async` | If `true`, Claude continues without waiting for completion |
| `continueOnBlock` | Prompt hooks: continue after `ok: false` on supported events, including `PreToolUse` and `PostToolUse` |

## Exit codes

| Code | Meaning |
|------|---------|
| `0` | Success; valid JSON may still deny an action |
| `2` | Blocking on supported events; behavior varies by event |
| Other non-0 | Usually a nonblocking error without decision JSON |

For `PreToolUse` hooks, exit 2 prevents the tool from executing. Claude reads the stderr message and can adapt its behavior.

## Synchronous vs Asynchronous

Keep validation synchronous. `async: true` runs a command hook in the background and cannot stop the action; use it for notifications or logging. Formatting in the background can race with subsequent edits.

## stdin data flow

```json
{
  "tool_name": "Edit",
  "tool_input": { "file_path": "src/auth.ts" },
  "tool_response": { "success": true },
  "hook_event_name": "PostToolUse"
}
```

`Stop` includes `last_assistant_message`. Full decisions and exceptions: [Hooks reference](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/hooks).
